title: Tool Registry Contract Schema
description: SSOT for ALL tools (built-in + MCP). Every side-effect tool must have an entry (C3, D7). Tools is an object map keyed by tool name.

tools.description: Map of tool name → tool definition

surface.description: Where the tool lives. 'virtual' is a marker with no executor behind it — it exists so a stage can be authorized to record an outcome (e.g. a QA verdict) without being handed a real side-effect tool to do it.

then.description: A virtual tool that could claim a side-effect would defeat its own purpose: the registry is what tells the guard which calls are dangerous, so a marker must be provably harmless or it becomes a hole to smuggle real actions through.
